name: io.github.tukorama/mcp-server-everesteer
title: Everesteer (unofficial)
description: Agent-first MCP server and LangGraph tools for the Everesteer prediction tournament API. Unofficial.

environmentVariables.name: EVERESTEER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Everesteer API key (or EIQ_API_KEY). Not needed after `mcp-server-everesteer auth`.

environmentVariables.name: EVERESTEER_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Tool groups to expose, e.g. auto, all, or auto,+staking,+equities.

environmentVariables.name: EVERESTEER_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose prediction, model, diagnostics, compute, and account write tools.

environmentVariables.name: EVERESTEER_ALLOW_STAKING
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose USDC staking, allocation, claim, and per-model stake plan tools.

environmentVariables.name: EVERESTEER_ALLOW_WITHDRAWALS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose USDC withdrawal and destructive emergency tools.

environmentVariables.name: EVERESTEER_MAX_DAILY_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Maximum USDC committed per UTC day across staking or withdrawals (default 1000).

environmentVariables.name: EVERESTEER_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directories (os.pathsep-separated) that download tools may write into; defaults to the server's working directory.

environmentVariables.name: CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional Cloudflare Access service token client id (for staging hosts).

environmentVariables.name: CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional Cloudflare Access service token secret.
